P1_pi1.note: Tietze-reduced presentation of pi_1(NG(C)), plus rational Betti numbers. Records >200 vertices skipped.
P1_pi1.reason: pi_1 Tietze-reduces to (0 gens, 0 rels) on every tested record in both sub and at classes. b_1 = 0 universally. Matches E2's null result — no commutator-based fillings.

P2_linking.note: Ad-hoc Lambda[q,q'] = #(adjacent mover-class transitions q->q') - reverse. Resulting matrix is antisymmetric by construction.
P2_linking.reason: det Lambda = 0 on every record. Implementation is rank-deficient antisymmetric (A - A^T on a cyclic ring), so zero-det is structurally forced. Even rank does not split by (sub,at); rank depends on (n, L) buckets only (n=5: rank 4, n=6: rank 4, n=7: rank 6). Fails pre-commit SURVIVES condition by both named tripwires (det=0 identically AND det depends only on (n,L)).

P3_zeta_f.note: Orbit-length multiset of the canonical forced-total-f map (f defined via lex-first move, fix elsewhere). Reported on NG only.
P3_zeta_f.reason: Sub-threshold records split into two camps: pure-binary multisets (ms=[2,...,2]) exhibit period-L orbits in NG, other multisets exhibit only fixed points. Both at-threshold records (Sol3v1 proxies, ms=[2,3,...,3]) also exhibit only fixed points. The signal is driven by multiset composition (pure-binary vs non-binary), NOT by threshold status. Reclassified RED: confounded statistic.

P6_cheeger.note: Spectral Cheeger lower bound h >= lambda_2 / 2 of undirected symmetrization of forced-NG digraph.
P6_cheeger.reason: lambda_2 = 0 on every record in both classes — forced-NG graph has >=2 connected components uniformly, so Cheeger constant is zero regardless of threshold. Probe gives no discriminating signal. Note: this reproduces the coverage-inversion pattern §0.6 predicted — sub-threshold forced-NG has MORE edges (coverage 1.1-1.8 vs ~1.0 at-threshold) but is still disconnected because forced successors cluster on local orbits rather than mixing globally.
